items.name: Sanctum Bound
items.text: Yig's faithful can move freely throughout Yig's avatar but can't leave it.

items.name: (Ghost) Rejuvenation
items.text: When a last guard is destroyed, they re-form after 2d4 days within the location they're bound to, fully healed. A last guard can be permanently destroyed and move on to the afterlife only if they successfully defend the location they're bound to from large-scale attack, or fulfill a call to war.

items.name: Frightful Battle Cry
items.text:
The last guards unleash a soul-shaking bellow in unison. All creatures in a 60-foot cone take 7d6 sonic damage (DC 42 basic Will save). Any creature that fails its save is also Frightened 3 (or Frightened 4 on a critical failure).

If the troop occupies 8 or fewer squares, this area decreases to a 30-foot cone.

items.name: Ghostly Fangs
items.text:
1 to 3

---
Frequency once per round

---
Effect Yig's faithful strike out with sacred punching daggers against each enemy within 5 feet (DC 40 basic Reflex save save). The damage depends on the number of actions.

1 1d8+2 slashing,1d8 void damage

2 2d8+14 slashing,2d8 void damage

3 3d8+14 slashing,3d8 void damage

items.name: Spectral Charge
items.text: The last guards charge, swarming through their foes. The troop Flies up to double its Speed, dealing 4d8 void damage to each creature whose space it moves through (DC 40 basic Reflex save). Any creature that fails its save is also Drained 1 (or Drained 2 on a critical failure). The troop can affect each creature only once in a single use of Spectral Charge.
